messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not use losartan if you are allergic to losartan.
If you have diabetes, do not take losartan with any medication that contains aliskiren.
Aliskiren is a blood pressure medicine.
To make sure losartan is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
heart disease or congestive heart failure;
an electrolyte imbalance (such as high levels of potassium in your blood);
if you are on a low-salt diet;
liver disease; or
kidney disease.
You may also need to avoid taking losartan with aliskiren if you have kidney disease.
Stop using losartan and tell your doctor right away if you become pregnant.
Losartan can cause injury or death to the unborn baby.
You should not breastfeed while using losartan and for 2 days after your last dose.
Triplet: ["losartan", "has pregnancy warning", "can cause injury or death to unborn baby"]

The relation 'has pregnancy warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause harm to the unborn baby if used during pregnancy, as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
D. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
E. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
